cards.question: What are scoped threads used for?
cards.answer: To spawn threads that finish execution before the scope is exited.

cards.question: Why can scoped threads borrow local variables?
cards.answer: Because they finish before the scope exits, so the data outlives their scope.

cards.question: What happens to threads spawned in a scope before the scope exits?
cards.answer: All of them are joined before the scope exits.

cards.question: What references can scoped threads share?
cards.answer: Multiple read references can be shared across threads, but only one mutable reference is allowed at a time.
